Commit Message Guide for Conventional Commits
Format
type(scope): subject

Description (optional)
Allowed types
feat: new functionality, behavior change, or removal of a feature.
fix: bug fix or fixing tests broken by a feat change.
refactor: internal change that does not modify behavior.
test: only changes in test files and not a fix.
style: only formatting/style (spacing, quotes, import order, linters) with no logic changes.
build: changes to build, dependencies, or project tooling (e.g., CI, Docker, requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, build scripts).
Scope
The module name within the current context.
If it has multiple words, use hyphens: file-management, user-service, db-migrations.
Subject
Clear and concise, briefly explaining what and why.
In present tense and without initial capital letter.
No trailing period.
Description (optional)
Expand on motivation, context, risks, or migration notes.
May include bullets, issue references, or verification steps.
